description: Start a cited pre-call research brief on one prospect: company, funding, traction, competitors, news, people, risks, regions, social (their X account and Reddit mentions, when found), plus a `fit` section when you pass `context`. Give exactly ONE identifier (domain, website_url, company_name, company_linkedin_url, a work email, or linkedin_url), or person_name together with company_name. Returns `research_id` at once; the brief takes 20 to 90 seconds, so poll research_get every 10 to 15 seconds until `status` is `completed` or `failed`. Costs one research at the price account_balance reports as `research_price_usd`, held when you submit, charged only when the brief completes and refunded in full if it fails. Free records do not apply.

company_linkedin_url.description: The company's linkedin.com/company/... URL, used as a name hint only.

company_name.description: The company's name. With person_name, the company that person works at.

context.description: Your own product, at most 1,000 characters. Turns on the `fit` section.

email.description: A work email; its domain identifies the company. Free-mail addresses are refused.

linkedin_url.description: A person's linkedin.com/in/... URL, used as a name hint only.

person_name.description: A person's name; needs company_name as well.

purpose.description: What the brief is for: `account_research` (default), `pre_call` (objections, discovery questions) or `outreach` (sourced hooks with draft first lines).

website_url.description: Any http(s) URL on the company's website.

name: research_submit
title: Start Prospect Research
